overview_description.description:
Memberstack is a SaaS product that enables Webflow developers to quickly add secure user accounts and payments. It allows businesses to launch custom software more quickly, reduce complexity, and save a lot of money without sacrificing design or functionality.

The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Williamsburg, Virginia.

about_short_description.short_description: Turn websites into members-only sites, dashboards, web apps, and intranets.

product.name: Memberships for Webflow
product.description: A platform to add user accounts, subscriptions, and gated content to Webflow sites without changing the existing tech stack.

product.name: Commenting
product.description: A commenting system that can be added to Webflow sites with customizable UI and social authentication.

product.name: Admin API & DOM Package
product.description: Developer tools including APIs and DOM packages to interact with Memberstack data and customize functionality.

product.name: Hosted Content
product.description: A feature to securely host and serve HTML content and links only to authenticated members.

product.name: Payment Processing and Subscription Management
product.description: Integration with Stripe to accept payments, manage subscriptions, and handle billing globally.
